title: AQE Alert Inbox record (D-62, extended D-82)
x_note: AQE writes one JSON object per line (JSONL) to aegis/data/alerts/DATE/inbox.jsonl INSTEAD OF EMAIL. The Aegis market-watch session reads this, never the PM's mail client. D-82: cadence is now every 30 min (file, not email); alerts are scoped to TODAY's data/alerts/DATE/alert_list.json membership and tagged with the list category (A/B/C) that put the ticker on the longlist.

ts.description: ISO8601 UTC time the alert fired (the 30-min AQE cycle; 15-min pre-D-82)

category.description: D-82: which alert-list category (A=casting mat / B=5d-elder / C=voice nominations) put this ticker on today's longlist. String for a single category or an array when the ticker sits in more than one list. Optional (back-compat).

level.description: D-82: the price level the alert_type references (e.g. the +2%-over-prior-COB breakout level, the SL, or the target)

universe_date.description: the AQE alert-list date this alert is scoped to — must be TODAY (staleness is rejected)

on_strong_universe.description: AQE asserts this ticker is on today's alert-list membership (back-compat field)
